headword: {購入特典|こうにゅうとくてん}
gloss: purchase bonus; special gift or benefit included with a purchase

definitions.gloss: purchase bonus; special gift or benefit included with a purchase
definitions.explanation: Common in retail, especially for books, games, CDs, and online shopping.

examples.japanese: {購入特典|こうにゅうとくてん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ポストカード⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: A postcard is included as a purchase bonus.

examples.japanese: {初回|しょかい}{購入特典|こうにゅうとくてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}→数量限定：09822_suuryougentei⟧です。
examples.english: The first-edition purchase bonus is limited in quantity.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{購入特典|こうにゅうとくてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently you can get an exclusive purchase bonus if you pre-order at this store.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧ (purchase) and ⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧ (special benefit/privilege). Refers to bonus items or perks given to customers upon buying a product, particularly common in Japanese retail culture where different stores may offer different bonuses for the same product.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初回|しょかい}{購入特典|こうにゅうとくてん}: first-edition purchase bonus
- ⟦{先着|せんちゃく}→先着：08320_senchaku⟧{購入特典|こうにゅうとくてん}: first-come-first-served bonus
- ⟦{店舗|てんぽ}→店舗：12481_tenpo⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧{購入特典|こうにゅうとくてん}: store-specific purchase bonus
- {購入特典|こうにゅうとくてん}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with purchase bonus included

CULTURAL NOTE:
Purchase bonuses are deeply embedded in Japanese retail marketing. Anime, manga, and game releases frequently have different {購入特典|こうにゅうとくてん} depending on the retailer (Animate, Toranoana, Amazon, etc.), encouraging fans to buy from multiple stores. Common bonus items include clear files, postcards, tapestries, and exclusive cover art.
